title: Infant Nutrition
learningOutcomes: Understand the key ideas behind infant nutrition and why this topic matters for child development.
Learn practical skills and strategies that help apply infant nutrition in everyday parenting situations.
Build confidence using infant nutrition to support connection, safety, and positive family routines.

caseworkerSummary: This topic helps parents build practical skills related to infant nutrition. It supports safer, more consistent caregiving by improving understanding, strengthening emotional connection, and reducing stress in daily routines. This topic is suitable for parents who need guidance in applying positive parenting strategies and may benefit families working toward stability, reunification, or improved home safety.
